How the 60-day rollover works on AirtelTigo

AirtelTigo bundles carry a 60-day validity: the data is yours for 60 days from delivery and unused data rolls over inside that window. If you use data steadily, the bigger bundles are cheaper per GB — 50GB works out at GH₵3.86 per GB against GH₵4.00 per GB for 1GB.

Payment goes through Valmont-Pay — MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money or card. We never see or store your MoMo PIN: you approve every charge on your own phone.

Delivery starts the moment payment confirms. Most bundles arrive within minutes; it depends on the network at the time. Every order gets a tracking reference and an SMS confirmation.

If a delivery fails we retry it automatically (up to three attempts) and refund it automatically if it still won't complete. Wrong numbers are not refundable — check the line before you pay.

You can buy for any number — yours, a family member's or a customer's. You do not have to be the account holder, and the site warns you if the prefix you typed belongs to a different network.

Which numbers are AirtelTigo?

In our number checker these prefixes belong to AirtelTigo: 026, 027, 028. Note that 026 is shared with MTN, 027 is shared with MTN — Ghana allows number portability, so a prefix is a good hint, not a guarantee. If the line you enter looks like another network we warn you before you pay, because a bundle sent to the wrong network will not deliver and wrong-number orders cannot be refunded. The full list is on our Ghana network prefixes page.
